works.summary:
Jimin frowns down at his lap, fidgeting with his fingers. “I don’t want to inconvenience you.”

“You’re not an inconvenience.”

“Not even a minor one?”

“No.”

“But I bother you all the time,” Jimin points out.

Jungkook just stares at him. “I wish you’d bother me more often.”

Oh, Jimin thinks, and then promptly looks away.

Jeon Jungkook has orbited Park Jimin like a faithful planet for his entire life. He's never felt the need to stray away, not when Jimin has taught him what real devotion is. But when Jimin feels the need to put unnecessary distance between them, he has no choice but to reverse their roles — just so that he can pull him back with the inescapable force of a gravitational pull.

Or: in which Jungkook manages to rope Jimin into filming a new season for their show for completely innocent, non-selfish reasons, and Jimin is so busy repressing over a decade worth of feelings that he wouldn't know reciprocation if it hit him in the face with a baseball bat.
